depConstraints.description: The inside of the hexagon. The domain knows neither its ports nor anything that plugs into them.
depConstraints.remediation: Move the collaborator into layer:domain, or express the need as a port and let an adapter satisfy it.

depConstraints.description: A port is the domain's own statement of what it needs or offers, so it may name domain types and other ports.
depConstraints.remediation: A port that needs an adapter's type is describing an implementation; keep the type in layer:domain instead.

depConstraints.description: An adapter implements a port. It may not depend on another adapter — two adapters that talk to each other have made a driven side into a driving one.
depConstraints.remediation: Route the collaboration through a port, or promote the shared piece into layer:domain.

depConstraints.description: The composition root: the one place allowed to name a concrete adapter and wire it to a port.
depConstraints.remediation: Nothing inside the hexagon may import this layer; move the wiring outward rather than the dependency inward.

depConstraints.description: The hexagon's inside takes no third-party package at all, Node built-ins included — every capability arrives through a port.
depConstraints.remediation: Declare a port for the capability and implement it in layer:adapters, where the package belongs.
